name: Cheryl's Bahamas Taxi and Tours
brand_truth: Cheryl's driver is the one in navy and yellow holding a card with your name at Nassau arrivals.
buyer: Cruise passengers and resort guests (US, families, Spanish speakers) booking a Nassau airport ride or a private tour on a phone, afraid of being left at the airport or overpaying.

direction.type: T06 Wide grotesk (Syne variable 600-800 lowercase + Atkinson Hyperlegible 400/700)
direction.why: P14 deep blue and yellow are Cheryl's own uniform colours; a poster with a sign you put your name on is the brand truth; the ticket block is their real JotForm transfer booking; the dock keeps Pickup, Tours, Call under the thumb.

tier_why: A taxi and private tour operator: the product is a person holding your name and a day on the island, best shown with their own photos and an interaction, not real-time 3D.
concept_type: booking: airport transfer ticket (all JotForm fields) + private tour builder from 22 real stops, both sending a prefilled email

images.credit: Illustrative photography (Lovable asset project ip-assets-cheryl-s-bahamas-taxi-and-tours), replace with your own: a real Cheryl's driver holding a blank card at Nassau arrivals

pitch_line: Your guests already remember one thing about you: their name on your card at arrivals. This site starts there, books the ride in one ticket and lets them build a tour from your 22 stops.
assumptions: Hero photo is generated illustrative photography (driver in navy with yellow trim holding a blank card at an arrivals hall), labelled on the page; replace with a real photo of a Cheryl's driver
Tour presets (3-hour: forts, straw market, Cloisters; full day: forts, Love Beach, conch) are suggestions based on the two sample tours on their site
Forms send by email (no WhatsApp number was found)
Atkinson Hyperlegible draws a slashed zero by design
notes: awaiting independent critic (fix pass 1). Pass 1 changes: hero rebuilt around a generated arrivals photo where the typed name is written live in Permanent Marker on the card in the driver's hands, with a large name input as the main feature; dock hidden while the hero and the pickup ticket are on screen (one primary CTA per screen); pickup ticket staged in three steps (Flight, Who, Hotel) with a yellow stub that fills as steps complete, on a navy ground; tours page rebuilt as one editorial list (name large, one line, '+ add'), no card grid, no photo tags, a 4-photo strip of seen photos only; day ticket compacted to fit a laptop screen; widows and placeholder contrast fixed, h1 tracking -0.06em. BLIND: sandbox blocks outside images; QA screenshots route crops of their own photos; the generated hero photo ships in the site's public folder (arrivals-sign.jpg, decoded from the Lovable asset project). qa: 0 blockers (remaining mobile tap-target warning is the shared concept label button); distinct: closest unexso 60.
